notes.title: goto is now released!
notes.notes:
[b]goto[/b] is a minimalistic maze game which leads you to finish each level by moving in 4 directions, avoiding obstacles and clearing the path.
Every level has its own record amount of moves. For example, you have to complete level 0 by moving only 7 times. 
If you fail, you get 2 or 1 cube out of 3. But if you beat the record, you'll get a special achievement for each level.
Levels' complexity increases every time you pass a level. Can you beat the highest one?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/906880/goto/
